name: Lingua Spatial
tagline: A mixed-reality headset app that labels the objects around you in a language you are learning, with cultural facts.
problem: Vocabulary drills feel random and disconnected from culture.
solution: Object recognition on a headset labels surroundings in languages such as Nahuatl or Hausa, and spoken facts explain each object's cultural role.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at an object and hear its name and story.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 160 submissions.

lessons: Tie each word to an object and a cultural story to make it stick.
